[[sn:Antarctia, Goddess of the Southern Ocean]]Antarctia, Goddess of the Southern Ocean - A mysterious and elusive goddess, embodying the enigmatic and unforgiving nature of the Southern Ocean. She is associated with icebergs, glaciers, and the frozen wilderness of the Antarctic, and is believed to hold the secrets of the southernmost part of the world. She is revered as a protector of the delicate Antarctic ecosystem and a symbol of resilience and survival.
